content:
incident-bot: ALERT: detected spike in 429s for /v1/generate across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. rate-limiter service reports 4.3x normal reject rate. rolling window 1m. paging oncall.

maria: oncall here. getting paged, joining. any customer-visible outages? @lee any support tickets?

lee: seeing ~30 incoming tickets from EU customers about timeouts/429s starting ~10m ago. a few high-traffic customers on Dedicated complaining. severity TBD but multiple L2s now.

sam: I'm seeing the metrics. After yesterday's quota-config rollout we unintentionally tightened an exemptions map. policy->exemptions count dropped to 0 for token_type=reserved. Default bucket now applies and overthrottles system-level and internal agents.

jon: timeline? which rollout? can we flip a flag?

sam: deploy-bot shows config rollout at 2212343000 (earlier today). change: "quota-service:policy-v2" pushed with new matching engine. The regexp for exemption keys ended up double-escaping, so match fails. 

deploy-bot: CI/CD note: /deploy quota-service policy-v2 -> SUCCESS 2212343000. Rollout percentage: 100% (gradual rollout policy completed)

maria: ok, mitigation plan. Options: 1) flip feature flag to revert matching engine 2) patch exemptions map in place 3) create emergency bypass for known customer tokens. Which is fastest?

sam: fastest is emergency bypass (hotfix) to re-add exemptions into the existing policy in-memory. fallback is flag flip but that requires coordinated redeploy and may take longer to converge across regions.

jon: downside of bypass? security/BL? It needs to be scoped to token ids we know. Do we have list of affected token prefixes?

lee: support gave us top 50 affected tokens (anonymized prefixes) and customer severity: 5 customers with high revenue impacted.

emily: logging note: token accounting may also be reporting wrong counts because exemptions not applied — billing signals could be skewed. need to include billing in customer impact message.

maria: sam, can you push emergency bypass to quota-service in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 in parallel? call it "emergency:exempt-reserved-hotfix". I'll coordinate comms and open incident channel.

sam: on it. patch below (applied via k8s exec into leader):

```
# emergency patch
kubectl exec -n quota svc/quota-leader -- /bin/sh -c \
  'curl -sS -XPOST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/patch-exemptions \
    -d "{\"prefixes\":[\"tok_rsvd_abc\",\"tok_rsvd_def\"]}"'
```

sam: patch applied to eu-west-1 leader. waiting for propagation.

incident-bot: NOTE: policy-change detected: emergency:exempt-reserved-hotfix applied by sam at 2212345123

lee: support reporting drop in new tickets for those customers in eu-west-1. us-west-2 still noisy.

maria: sam, can you tail logs and confirm 429s drop and also confirm token accounting still consistent (no negative counters)?

sam: logs show 429s falling ~80% in eu-west-1 after patch. token accounting service still showing temporal drift: some tokens reported extra rejected tokens while the exemption was missing earlier. I'll run reconciliation job to correct counters.

emily: please note: reconciliation may change billing-visible token totals. we'll need to coordinate with finance to avoid auto-invoicing anomalies this billing cycle.

jon: for immediate customer comms: message draft: "We've identified and mitigated a quota configuration regression introduced in a recent policy rollout that caused exemptions to be ignored, leading to elevated 429s for some customers. We applied an emergency exemption patch and are verifying traffic. No changes to customer tokens or billing will be applied until reconciliation is complete." Thoughts?

lee: 👍 keeps it non-technical but transparent. add expected ETA: 2h for verification, 12-24h for reconciliation.

maria: good. I'm escalating to Sev2. tagging product and finance. @jon please own external comms with support.

jon: on it. publishing to status page and contacting top 5 accounts via AMs.

deploy-bot: NOTE: rollback flag available: /featureflag quota_matching_v2 -> OFF. Rollback requires a rolling restart of quota-service across regions; estimate 12-18m to converge per region.

sam: I'm going to also prepare the rollback plan in case bypass doesn't hold. steps: 1) disable feature flag, 2) restart leader pods, 3) validate exemptions restored. I'll coordinate with eng-sre to avoid cascading restarts.

maria: handoff plan: I'm on for next 30m. after that, sam will be primary. @emily track billing impact and set up finance alert.

emily: added a finance alert: watch invoice_token_counts and billing_rates. will notify if reconciliation changes exceed 0.5%.

sam: us-west-2 bypass applied at 2212345430. 429s down ~70% there. some delayed clients still retrying and hitting transient 5xxs, working on retry-backoff tuning.

lee: customers on Dedicated reported restored throughput. Support updating threads.

maria: can we add a temporary policy-level metric: exemptions_applied_count and exemptions_miss_count? want to catch regression quicker.

sam: adding metric now. will emit count per policy shard and push to Datadog; dashboard link: https://app.datadog.com/dash/xyz/quota-exemptions (internal)

incident-bot: UPDATE: incident severity changed to Sev2 (partial customer impact) at 2212345500

jon: published status: "Partial disruption to API requests for a subset of customers due to quota config error. Mitigation applied. We're monitoring and will update in 30 minutes." posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents

maria: next steps checklist: - verify 429s stable for 60m - run token accounting reconcile job and hold billing actions - build postmortem with root cause (regexp escaping bug in config parser) - prioritize e2e test for exemptions matching in CI

sam: recon job started: /ops/reconcile_tokens --since=2212342000 --fix-duplicates. I'll post results when done.

emily: finance will hold invoices for affected customers until reconciliation complete and will coordinate credits if needed.

lee: support will follow up with customers with the ETA included.

maria: if bypass holds for next 30m and reconcile shows no material billing deltas, we'll close the incident and follow up with a postmortem. otherwise, plan B is featureflag rollback.

sam: reconcile complete: adjustments: 124 tokens with >0 drift, total delta 0.12% of monthly token volume for affected accounts. corrections scheduled and finance notified.

emily: finance OK with reconciliation adjustments, no immediate refunds; we'll issue credits if customers request per policy.

maria: excellent. I'm closing the active pager. creating incident ticket and assigning to sam for postmortem and to eng-sre for CI test. Thanks team. :tada:

incident-bot: RESOLVED: incident 2212345678 closed at 2212345800. root cause: config parsing change in quota-service policy-v2 that double-escaped exemption keys, causing match failure and overthrottling.
